'''Corsair Cove''' is a small port town located on the southern shore of [[Feldip Hills]]. It is isolated from the rest of the area by large impassable cliffs. Unlike most of the western part of the [[world map]], the cove is accessible to [[free-to-play]] players, after starting [[The Corsair Curse]] [[quest]].

==Transportation==
Players can be automatically ferried to the Cove by speaking to various NPCs. If [[The Corsair Curse]] is not started, players can speak with [[Captain Tock]] north of [[Port Sarim]]. Once started, players can speak to Captain Tock on the western end of [[Rimmington]]. Players can speak to [[Cabin Boy Colin#Post-quest (Rimmington)|Cabin Boy Colin]] in this same location after completing the quest. (To return to Rimmington, speak to Captain Tock during the quest, or [[Cabin Boy Colin#Post-quest (Rimmington)|Cabin Boy Colin]] post-quest aboard the ship at Corsair Cove.)

With [[The Corsair Curse]] completed, players with 40 [[Sailing]] can dock at the cove.

Other transport options which bring players into or close to Corsair Cove listed with their arrival destination, from closest to farthest:
* {{plink|Charter ships|pic=War ship}} — main docks.
* {{Plink|Teleport to Boat}} — Corsair Cove [[File:Docking_point_icon.png]] [[mooring point]] once a [[Boat|player-owned boat]] with a [[Greater teleport focus (facility)|greater teleport focus]] is docked there (with 40 [[Sailing]] and [[The Corsair Curse]] completed)
* {{Plink|Spirit trees|pic=Spirit tree (Construction) icon}} — Feldip Hills, south-west of the town.
* {{plink|Mythical cape}} — [[Myths' Guild]], west of the town, from the basement.
* {{plink|Hunter cape}} or [[max cape]] — [[Feldip Hunter area]], north of the town.
With 10 [[Agility]], players can access Corsair Cove via the Feldip Hills by climbing the [[Rocks (Corsair Cove)|rocks]] south of the [[Feldip Hunter area]]. Players can also climb the [[Rocks (Corsair Cove Resource Area)|rocks]] near the resource area with 30 Agility, after completion of [[Dragon Slayer I]] and having spoken to [[Haris]].

== History ==
{{LoreSources|Arsen the Thief|The Corsair Curse|Madame Caldarium|Chief Tess|dialogue1=yes|dialogue3=yes|dialogue4=yes}}

It is unknown when Corsair Cove was formed, but it was likely first settled by [[Captain Tock]] and his crew. Because settling in the area meant that a navigator was no longer needed, the [[Ithoi the Navigator|navigator of Tock's crew]] attempted to poison them, in order to convince them they were cursed. With an [[Player character|adventurer]]'s help, Ithoi's plot was revealed and he was killed, ending the "curse".

West of the cove, a group of [[ogress]]es living underground plan to get rid of the Corsairs and expand to the surface, while [[Madame Caldarium]] plans to expand her spa business.

==Locations==

=== Corsair Cove docks ===
The Corsair Cove docks feature a [[shipwright]], making them a convenient place for players to recover their boats to if they need to reach the [[Shrouded Ocean|Shrouded]] or [[Unquiet Ocean|Unquiet Oceans]]. 

Additionally, the [[charter ship]]s have a dock in Corsair Cove, providing rides across [[Gielinor]]. Completion of [[Cabin Fever]] will reduce fares by 50%, as will wearing the [[Ring of Charos(a)]]. The two reductions in price stack together.
{{Charter ship fares}}

=== Skill training spots ===
There are three net/bait [[fishing spots]] south-west of the town. However, the major skill-training opportunities are found in the [[Corsair Cove Resource Area|resource area]], and the cove's [[Corsair Cove Dungeon|dungeon]].

* Immediately west of the main area is a hole leading into the [[Corsair Cove Dungeon]]. The dungeon is a useful location for both members and free players to fight level 82 [[Ogress Warrior|ogress warrior]]s and [[Ogress Shaman|ogress shaman]]s, which are notable for their [[rune full helm]], [[limpwurt root]], and [[shaman mask]] drops. North-west of the underground dungeon is a [[List of mines|mining site]] with 5 [[coal rocks|coal]], 2 [[mithril rocks|mithril]] and 1 [[adamantite rocks|adamantite]] rocks, as well as an exit to the resource area.

* North-west of the port is the [[Corsair Cove Resource Area]], which is only accessible by speaking to [[Haris]] after completion of [[Dragon Slayer I]]. The area features 3 [[yew tree]]s, 4 [[maple tree]]s, and 3 cage/harpoon [[Fishing spots]]. Using the resource area's fishing spot in conjunction with the deposit box outside the Corsair Cove bank can yield slightly faster trips (around 6 seconds there and back) over running from Karamja's lobster/swordfish spots to the boat then to Port Sarim deposit box. It will however drain more run energy due to there being no loading time while on the boat, but you will save on gold and have another inventory slot for fishing.

==Sailing info==
Players can [[mooring point|dock]] at the Corsair Cove with level 40 [[Sailing]], provided they have also completed [[The Corsair Curse]]. The dock south-east of the town offers the following utilities for sailors, though many are unusable until the quest is completed:
*[[File:Shipwright map icon.png|link=Shipwright]] [[Shipwright]]
*[[File:Port task board icon.png|link=Notice board]] [[Notice board]]
*[[File:Salvaging station map icon.png|link=Salvaging station]] [[Salvaging station]]
*[[File:Ledger table icon.png|link=Ledger table]] [[Ledger table]]
*[[File:Bank icon.png|link=Bank deposit box]] [[Bank deposit box]]

A [[Rowboat (amenity)|rowboat]] can be built on [[Angler's Retreat]], requiring 51 Sailing to moor there and 50 [[Construction]] to build. Once built, it can be used to move quickly between Angler's Retreat and the Corsair Cove.

==Inhabitants==
=== Personalities ===
*{{Chatl|Altarkiz}}, a Bedabin nomad{{CitePostbag|issue=24|author=Altarkiz|letter=Oh, yes, I'm from the desert. Haris and I signed up with Captain Tock's crew because we were looking for some real adventure.|name=}} who can't be spoken with due to his deep meditative concentration.
*{{Chatl|Arsen the Thief}}, a kleptomaniac who isn't very good at what he does.
*{{Chatl|Cabin Boy Colin|txt=Cabin boy Colin}}, a young boy who pilots Captain Tock's ship.
*{{Chatl|Captain Tock}}, a corsair captain with a cursed crew.
*{{Chatl|Chief Tess}}, the boss of the ogre dungeon.
*{{Chatl|Francois}}, Arsen's brother and more successful half.
*{{Chatl|Gnocci the Cook}}, the chef for the Corsairs.
*{{Chatl|Haris}}, a proud Bedabin who only allows sufficiently heroic players to enter his dungeon.
*{{Chatl|Ithoi the Navigator}}, a mage who resorts to lies and violence after being threatened with being let go.
*{{Chatl|Lord Marshal Brogan}}, a commander planning an invasion of the land.
*{{Chatl|Madame Caldarium}}, a business-minded pirate hoping to open up a spa.
*{{Chatl|Port master|pic=Port master (Corsair Cove) chathead}}, who helps players with their [[port tasks]].
*{{Chatl|Shipwright Soraya}}, who helps players recover and customise their [[Boat|boats]].
*Two {{Chatl|Trader Crewmember|txt=trader crewmembers|pic=Trader Crewmember (3) chathead}}, who ferry players for high prices.
*{{Chatl|Yusuf}}, the Corsair Cove banker.

==Oo'glog==
[[File:Corsair spa.png|thumb]]
The town of Corsair Cove was designed as a precursor to {{RSL|Oo'glog}}, an ogre city first introduced to ''[[RuneScape 2]]'' on 29 January 2008.{{CiteReddit|author=Mod West|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/2007scape/comments/71z5kq/suggestioninstead_of_corsair_can_we_get_ooglog_so/dnei91u/|title=[Suggestion]Instead of corsair, can we get Oo'glog so that we dont stray too far away from rs3 lore?|quote=I've designed that place to purposefully be a precursor to oo'glog :)|date=23 September 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/96751|archivedate=14 June 2022}} In Corsair Cove, [[Madame Caldarium]] can be found next to a rock tub, mirroring the appearance of Oo'glog's spas. Furthermore, her daughter is {{RSL|Balnea}} from ''RuneScape 3'', whom players meet during the quest {{RSL|As a First Resort}}.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod West|url=https://twitter.com/JagexWest/status/939052146061922305|date=8 December 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/100642|archivedate=30 May 2020|quote=[Is Madame Caldarium actually Balnea from the live game?] Nope, she is her mother and the Dragon Inn barkeep is her husband. Not sure there is a reference to that in game, but that's the canon.}}

When spoken to, Madame Caldarium will reveal that she is planning to start a spa business in the Corsair Cove with the ogresses in the [[Corsair Cove Dungeon]].
